setup.input_units: native; encoder units are twice the detents

steps.caption: Slot 1 has channel 1 muted and slot 2 has both channels audible, each 16 steps with Repeats 1 and Song mode On. The project has not been saved under a name yet and playback is stopped.
steps.title: Starting point

steps.caption: Tap K1 briefly for the norns menu, turn E1 to PARAMS and press K3, open MOSAIC and turn E2 to < Save project. The norns menu lists Pattern project management with Save project selected.
steps.title: Open Save project

steps.caption: Press K3 on < Save project. The norns text entry screen opens with the suggested name new: press K3 on DEL to delete it, then turn E2 to each character of Four notes and press K3 to enter it, and confirm. Saving writes Four notes.ptn and Four notes.pset. Tap K1 to return to Mosaic, which still shows SLOT SETUP, SONG 01; the text entry itself is on the norns menu, not on this frame.
steps.title: Save the arrangement

steps.caption: Tap Channel (3,8), then hold K1, tap (1,1) and release K1. The title reads CH01 with no MUTE and the tooltip says Channel 1 unmuted: slot 1 now plays the phrase. This change is not saved.
steps.title: Make an unsaved change

steps.caption: Tap K1, open PARAMS > MOSAIC and turn E2 to > Load project. The norns menu shows Load project selected; K2 would cancel the dialog.
steps.title: Open Load project

steps.caption: Turn E2 until Four notes.ptn is highlighted. Confirm the filename before pressing K3 to load it.
steps.title: Select Four notes

steps.caption: Press K3 on > Load project, turn E2 to Four notes in the file list and press K3, then tap K1 to return to Mosaic and tap Channel (3,8). The title reads CH01 MUTE again: the unsaved change is gone and slot 1 is bass alone.
steps.title: Reload the saved version

steps.caption: Select slot 1, tap Play (1,8) and listen. SLOT SETUP, SONG 01 is on screen and the bass alone (48, 55) sounds, as before the save.
steps.title: Replay slot 1

steps.caption: Keep listening: the screen follows the song to SONG 02 and the phrase and pickup join the bass, as in chapter 9. Let four 16-step sections run, then tap Play to stop. The MIDI strip lists the same notes as the arrangement in chapter 9.
steps.title: Replay slot 2
